summary: v219 ties the v1 controller mappings, route constants, and endpoint pair registry together so future split work cannot omit or leak routes.
guards: v1 controller exposes nine GET mappings
controller route suffixes match the v1 endpoint pair live endpoints after removing the shared base path
all v1 route constants start with /v1-contract- and are unique
fixture endpoint count matches controller route count
read-only evidence catalog and evidence index routes remain outside the v1 contract route group
